messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — planning to roll an autoscale policy update to dedicated-gpu-pool-2 in the 18:00 UTC deploy window today. Change: lower min_replicas from 2 -> 1 and add burst_capacity=4 for short spikes. I'll be the primary deployer. Who's available for smoke and rollback readiness?

maya: I reviewed the change. Sounds fine but we need a short smoke checklist before we promote. I'll own the smoke script.

jamie: oncall this window. I'll monitor infra and can trigger rollback if we see sustained errors or GPU saturation. Ping me when canary starts.

ops: Rollback plan: revert the terraform commit and run `terraform apply -target=module.dedicated_gpu.pool` to force previous state. If autoscaler misfires, scale pool to previous replica count manually: `rctl scale dedicated-gpu-pool-2 --replicas=2`. Watch GPU util >90% for 3+ minutes.

maya: Smoke steps (keeps it minimal):
```
# smoke script (local)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" 
  -d '{"model":"dedicated-gpu-pool-2/model-v2","prompt":"smoke test"}' 
# check response < 1200ms and no OOMs in pod logs
# verify KV cache hit rate increases after warmup
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy by alex at 2026-03-15T18:00:00Z to channel #eng-releases. :rocket:

alex: I'm opening a small infra PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1234 — will set canary to 10% of pool for first 30m.

maya: Canary plan: 10% for 30m, run smoke script every 5m. If any of these break: 1) error rate > 3% 2) median latency up > 30% 3) GPU util > 85% for 5m => rollback.

sre-oncall: I'll subscribe to traces and tail `dedicated-gpu-pool-2` pod logs. Will warm KV cache after canary hits live. Please @jamie for immediate pager if anything spikes.

alex: PR merged, starting canary in ~5m. tagging everyone. :thumbsup:

maya: Noted. I'll post smoke run results in this thread after first 10m.

jamie: Ready. Monitoring dashboard linked: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/dedicated-gpu-pool-2

ops: Added short playbook to the PR for rollback steps and contact list.

alex: Canaries looking okay at +12m. One small latency blip but resolved after cache warm. Continuing to 30m.

maya: Smoke runs: 0 failures in last 3 runs. Good to promote on my end after 30m unless anyone objects.

jamie: No objections. I'll keep monitoring for the next hour.

sre-oncall: Promotion started at +31m. Will post if anomalies.

alex: Promotion complete. Thanks team. :tada:
